The '''9000 Z001 landspeeder''' was a [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian]] model commonly used around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was modified from the [[9000 landspeeder]], which had been aimed at [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] customers but had flopped.<ref name="GG7" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:FromTheAbyss-SbtDS.png|thumb|left|250px|A 9000 Z001 landspeeder outside Chalmun's Cantina]]
Six-point-eight meters in diameter, it carried a single pilot, two passengers, and 50 kilograms of cargo. It could be modified to sit up to six humanoids.<ref name="sj">{{GamerCite|2|Snow Job}}</ref> The craft hovered up to three meters above the ground and its numerous viewports allowed its driver an excellent field of vision. While not the speediest of vehicles, able to achieve only 160 kilometers per hour, a ring of micro-thrusters around the hull granted exceptional maneuverability.

The 9000 Z001 was the predecessor of the [[9000 Z004 landspeeder|9000 Z004 model]].

==History==
At some point before [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], [[Feena Ghel]] was selling one unit of this vehicle, customized for the local frozen conditions, in [[Elesa]], capital city of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]].<ref name="sj" />

[[File:9000_landspeeder.png|thumb|A parked 9000 Z001 landspeeder.]]
One of these vehicles was seen parked outside [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

The [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] [[Karoly D'ulin]] used one of these vehicles to follow the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Zothip]] nearly two decades later.

==Behind the scenes==
This model appears to be a reference to [[Wikipedia:Stanley Kubrick|Stanley Kubrick]] and his film [[Wikipedia:2001: A Space Odyssey|''2001: A Space Odyssey'']], as noted by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], whereas [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian]] was at one time spelled "Ubrickkian", and 9000 refers to [[Wikipedia:HAL 9000|HAL 9000]].<ref>{{Twitter|infinata|status/150430963938246656|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|nobackup=1}}</ref>

''[[The Star Wars Album]]'' and the [[July 4]], [[1982]] Sunday Edition of the [[Star Wars (comic strip)|''Star Wars'' comic strip's]] [[Star Wars Scrapbook|scrapbook section]] both referred to the 9000 Z001 landspeeder as a "low-life droid" who was seeking a one-way passage out of Mos Eisley.<ref name="SWA">''[[The Star Wars Album]]''</ref>
